notes: Synthetic: from Together's OpenAPI spec as embedded in its official SDK, github.com/togethercomputer/together-py scripts/mock at 3428f80887121c5715f670f3cffa71b2ed482c12 (2026-10-28; pinned as contractspec/subsets/together), POST /v1/completions: CompletionRequest's examples (model mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1, the prompt) and CompletionResponse (id, object "text.completion", created, model, prompt[], choices[] {text, seed, finish_reason, logprobs}, usage), with no response example: the id, timestamps, text, seed and token counts are placeholders, the answer ending with "eos" (FinishReason: stop, eos, length, tool_calls, function_call). The gateway never streams /v1/completions upstream (TextCompletion sets stream false), so there is no stream case. Error cases: the operation's 4xx answers are ErrorData ({error: {message, type, param, code}}), whose type and code are free strings; their values are the ones the same spec documents for Together's errors: the error categories of the queue endpoints' QueueError ("invalid_request_error", "not_found_error") and the error codes of its realtime endpoints (invalid_api_key "Invalid API key provided (401)", model_not_available "Invalid or unavailable model (400)"), each message being its code's documented description. docs.together.ai was not reachable from the authoring sandbox.
